payload.reason: The evidence explains the difference between human evaluation accuracy and automatic evaluation F1 scores, indicating that higher absolute accuracy numbers compared to F1 scores suggest that human evaluators can assess correctness more comprehensively than automated systems, which may miss some correct answers.

claims.text: Higher absolute accuracy numbers compared to F1 scores indicate that human evaluators can assess correctness more comprehensively than automated evaluations.
The discrepancy arises because automatic evaluations may not capture all possible correct answers, leading to lower F1 scores.
